description: Type-check Rego with `opa check`. Returns `{ valid: true, errors: [] }` on success, or a list of structured diagnostics with file/line locations on failure. Provide either `source` for inline checking or `paths` for file/directory checking.

bundle.description: Load `paths` as bundle files or root directories (`--bundle`). Only valid with `paths`, not inline `source`.

capabilities.description: Path to a capabilities JSON file restricting allowed builtins.

maxErrors.description: Maximum number of errors to collect before `opa check` aborts compilation (`--max-errors`, OPA default 10). Raise it to surface more diagnostics from a badly broken policy in a single pass.

paths.description: Filesystem paths to check. Each path must be inside an allowed root (OPA_MCP_ALLOWED_PATHS).

source.description: Inline Rego source. Mutually exclusive with `paths`.

strict.description: Enable strict mode -- fail on unused vars, deprecated builtins, etc.

v0Compatible.description: Read the policy as Rego v0 (`--v0-compatible`), the syntax OPA used before 1.0: rules without `if`, partial sets as `deny[msg] { ... }`. Needed for a policy that has not been migrated, which OPA 1.x otherwise refuses to load. Where the tool also takes a query, the query is read as v0 too, with the future keywords imported so `in`, `every` and `some x in` still work in it.

name: rego_check
title: Check Rego
